dialogue.speaker: spirit
text: Direct contact with actual living creatures, after all this time...

dialogue.speaker: spirit
text: I'll finally be able to get out of this hell once and for all...

dialogue.speaker: spirit
text: You don't mind your bodies being borrowed right?
It's only fair...

dialogue.speaker: gooey-talk-pixel
text: Nu uh.

dialogue.speaker: spirit
text: ...What the frick do you MEAN nu uh?

dialogue.speaker: gooey-smug-pixel
text: Nu uh.

dialogue.speaker: spirit
text: Look, I don't think you get it. I am literally going to take over your bodies and leave you two stranded here.

dialogue.speaker: gooey-smug-pixel
text: Dude you look like someone ran over a ketchup packet I can not take you seriously.

dialogue.speaker: gooey-pixel
text: Flora wanna help me make fun of this guy?

dialogue.speaker: gooey-talk-pixel
text: ...Flora?

dialogue.speaker: gooey-talk-pixel
text: Oh.

dialogue.speaker: flora-spirit-pixel
text: One step closer to freedom, after so, so long...
I can almost feel the outside world again.

dialogue.speaker: gooey-smug-pixel
text: Dude are you feeling okay? I think you might have pink eye.

dialogue.speaker: flora-spirit-pissed-pixel
text: Holy crap can you take literally ANYTHING seriously I am actively possessing your sister and you don't seem to care at all.

dialogue.speaker: gooey-pixel
text: Nah, shes probably fine. Right Flora?

dialogue.speaker: flora-anime-pixel
text: yeah

dialogue.speaker: flora-spirit-shocked-pixel
text: What the actual flip flop?

dialogue.speaker: gooey-smug-pixel
text: I got some eyedrops if you want any.

dialogue.speaker: flora-spirit-shocked-pixel
text: YOU KNOW WHAT? GENUINELY FRICK YOU GUYS. I HAVE BEEN TRAPPED HERE FOR 13 YEARS AND THE ONE CHANCE I GET TO LEAVE-

dialogue.speaker: flora-spirit-pissed-pixel
text: I JUST GET CONSTANTLY INSULTED BY FRICKING DOLLAR STORE SLIME!? I AM GOING TO ACTUALLY BEAT BOTH OF YOU RIGHT HERE!

dialogue.speaker: gooey-smug-pixel
text: Someones a bit mad.

dialogue.speaker: flora-anime-pixel
text: So I know I was kinda joking before but Gooey this is actually really painful can you please do something?

dialogue.speaker: gooey-sad-pixel
text: Oh okay my bad.

dialogue.speaker: flora-spirit-pissed-pixel
text: Actually go away-
